This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their pale [[Color|pink]] or gray skin,  large, boney heads, solid, dark blue eyes, and lack of visible mouths.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Narkina 5 Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> a member of this species attended a party held at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] hosted by [[Perrin]] and [[Mon Mothma]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> In [[4 BBY]], a member of this species was in attendance at the wedding ceremony of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the planet [[Chandrila]].<ref name="One Year Later">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> In both [[3 BBY|3]]<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> and [[2 BBY]], at least two members of this species could be found within the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the planet [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> Much later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> yet another member of this species by the name of [[Letrun Pay]] was present at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in [[Canto Bight]] on [[Cantonica]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Letrun-Pay-Ivan-Manzella.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 55D by Ivan Manzella]]
Letrun Pay's species first appeared in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> This species was designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Ivan Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella - Creature & Character Designs|archivedate=20240604150100}}</ref> and were referred to by the production code "King 55D."<ref name="TLJ Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> When asked if this species were actually one and the same with the similarly described [[Setaran]] species<ref name="Setaran">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356693927054283054|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Setaran-Connection.png}}</ref> featured in ''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'', written by [[Cavan Scott]],<ref name="Path of Vengeance">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref> Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], stated that he didn't want to presume Scott's intent,<ref name="Setaran" /> but revealed that, as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref> He did, however, say it was definitely something he'd want to put a pin into until they needed to come up with a definitive answer, weighing authorial intent against the possibility of not having to invent a new species name.<ref name="Setaran" />

Similarly Cavan Scott's audiobook ''[[The Jaws of Jakku]]'',<ref name="JoJ">''[[The Jaws of Jakku]]''</ref> released on [[October 9]] later that same year,<ref name="Audible">{{Audible|domain=co.uk|url=pd/Star-Wars-The-Jaws-of-Jakku-Audiobook/B0DDYZJ3DV|text=Star Wars: The Jaws of Jakku}}</ref> identified<ref name="JoJ" /> the also previously unnamed species<ref name="Unnamed Aliens" /> of fellow ''The Last Jedi'' character [[Centada Ressad]] as [[Tallimarian]].<ref name="JoJ" />
